主要内容: On February 9, 2021, SCHWEITZER-MAUDUIT INTERNATIONAL, INC. amended its credit agreement to add a new Term Loan B facility of $350 million and a $500 million revolving line of credit. The amendment supports the proposed acquisition of Scapa Group Plc. The Term Loan B facility is expected to be completed by February 22, 2021, with a maturity of seven years after the closing date of the amendment. The $325 million from the revolving credit facility is unavailable until the acquisition is completed. The amendment requires the company to maintain financial ratios and secure borrowings with substantially all personal property, excluding customary collateral. The amendment is incorporated into the Form 8-K filing on February 10, 2021. The terms of the offer are described in a separate Form 8-K filed on January 27, 2021.
